style_suggestion.reasoning: The site presents a newly built, all-white, light-filled barn (Modern + Rustic) on the family's homestead farm with gardens and an outdoor pavilion (Outdoors). The only Classic cue is 'historic agricultural architecture', which describes the barn's inspiration, not a historic building. The current rules would still tag Classic from 'historic' in the corrected Description; a rule refinement would be to ignore 'historic' when it describes design inspiration ('draws on historic ...').
site_cues: takes barn inspo to a whole new level
all-white-everything space is flooded with natural light
grand pavilion used for outdoor ceremonies
Walker Family originally homesteaded this property

open_questions: Row was flagged as out-of-area (Riverton), but the linked official site is Walker Farms in Lindon, Utah County. The team should keep the row and update address/city/phone; the Riverton details in the old CSV seem to come from another business.
Who performs general cleanup? The site says clean-up time is part of the renter's reserved time; only table/chair takedown is listed as included.
Are linens available (included or rented)? The site does not mention them.
